title: Wiola架构：高效小型语言模型
summary: Wiola是一个从头构建的小型语言模型架构，包含五个原创组件：螺旋旋转位置编码、门控跨层注意力、自适应令牌合并、双流前馈网络和改进的归一化方法。提供四种规模（120M-1.5B参数），兼容HuggingFace生态。
summary_en: Wiola is a fully original SLM architecture with five novel components: Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding, Gated Cross-Layer Attention, Adaptive Token Merging, Dual Stream Feed-Forward, and WiolaRMSNorm. Available in four sizes (120M-1.5B), compatible with HuggingFace.
